about: Cabinet names and the key each is compared by. Venue.Normalize (NormalizeTests.cs) and lib/cabinetName.ts (cabinetName.test.ts) must both give these keys.

cases.name: the base Ⅱ
cases.why: Ⅱ is a letter-like number (Nl), not a decimal digit

cases.name: BASE²
cases.why: ² is another number (No), not a decimal digit

cases.name: straße
cases.why: ß has no one-letter capital, so it stays

cases.name: ﬁre
cases.why: the ligature's capital is two letters, so it stays

cases.name: ǅ
cases.why: a title-case letter has a one-letter capital

cases.name: Ｔａｉｋｏ１
cases.why: full-width letters and digits count, and keep their width
a decimal digit of another script counts
